description: This file defines a trait 'ProducesUnresolvedSubtree' used in Spark SQL's expression resolution process. It provides methods to handle resolution of subtrees within expressions, ensuring single-pass traversal and boundary tagging.

classes.name: ProducesUnresolvedSubtree
classes.description: A trait providing mechanisms to resolve subtrees within expressions while maintaining single-pass traversal boundaries.

methods.name: withResolvedSubtree
methods.description: Resolves a subtree within an expression, tagging boundaries to prevent re-resolution, and invokes a body function to perform resolution.

methods.name: tryPopSinglePassSubtreeBoundary
methods.description: Checks and removes the boundary tag from an expression to determine if subtree traversal should stop.
